x: All the great British long distance walkers and many of those from abroad have competed in this race, including Olympic medallists Tommy Green, Harold Whitlock, Lloyd Johnson, Don Thompson, Norman Read and Abdon Pamich.
Tommy was placed three times in this event. In 1930 at Derby he finished 3rd behind A.E.Plumb (North London H) and T.

We are very glad to see Tommy Green out again, and although he is not yet his old self, he has already been responsible for some very fine performances. Best of these, perhaps, was to beat T. Lloyd Johnson, the National 20 miles and 50 kilometres champion, in a 25 miles race at Manchester.
